session_note: Washington operates on a 2025-2026 biennium: the 2025 regular session (105 days) was followed by the 2026 regular session, a 60-day even-year short session that convened Monday 2026-01-12 and adjourned sine die on Thursday 2026-03-12 (verified via legislature session-dates records, and cross-checked against the bill pages below, where the last House floor action on any bill occurred on 2026-03-12 and enacted 2026 bills carry a 90-days-after-sine-die effective date of 2026-06-11). Bills introduced in 2025 that did not finish carry over automatically into the 2026 short session under the same bill number; any bill not passed by both chambers and signed by the governor before 2026-03-12 sine die is dead for the 2025-2026 biennium and would need to be reintroduced as a new bill in the 2027-2028 biennium.
